title: Gorp Worker Result
description: Source-neutral structured result a worker adapter returns for one node attempt. Implemented since Wave B; enriched in Sprint 5A: a worker now reports its own account of the attempt (summary, expectedFiles, reviewerNotes) instead of the control plane inferring everything from the git diff. summary/expectedFiles/reviewerNotes are optional here so pre-5A records stay valid; the adapter boundary requires a non-empty summary on every NEW result. changedFiles remains computed from git by the adapter, never trusted from the worker process.

workerAdapter.description: Abstract adapter name; never a concrete provider/runtime.

summary.description: The worker's own one-paragraph account of what it did (or why it failed/blocked). Required at the adapter boundary for every new result.

expectedFiles.description: Files the worker intended/expected to produce or change. Reviewers compare this claim against the git-computed changedFiles.

reviewerNotes.description: Free-text notes addressed to the human reviewer (e.g. the worker runtime's own closing output), truncated by the adapter.

changedFiles.description: Computed from git by the adapter — never the worker process's claim.

blocker.description: Structured blocker detail; kept here to avoid a separate blocker schema in Sprint 1.

usage.description: Optional per-run usage capture (GOS-55): tokens and cost are stamped only when the worker reports them (never estimated); durationMs is always present when usage is present.
